limitations: Labels are agent-reviewed, not independent ground truth. Repeatedly used validation layouts can overfit research choices.

Astral and new-camp diagnostic regions were reviewed after earlier predictions; these are observed test layouts, not fresh unseen validation.
Partial-region false counts exclude predictions outside reviewed areas; total peaks are reported separately.
Procedural test seeds measure the generator task, not real-world art accuracy.
